Title:
Artificial Intelligence Specialist (Shiraz)

Company:
Radhoosh | Radhoosh was established in 2015 by a group of IT specialists with experience in the field, aiming to focus on producing user-centric software and content management systems in Shiraz. Radhoosh is always striving to enhance knowledge, prepare the necessary infrastructure, and attract and train the required specialists. The Radhoosh company currently has a branch outside the country, where most of the company's activities are on high-level foreign projects. All projects are carried out with Agile management and follow principles of software design and implementation. We are currently recruiting talented specialists to increase competitiveness with foreign companies. If you have something to say in your specialized field and are interested in learning new methods in web design and game development, join our energetic group.

Fars

Job description:
We’re a forward-thinking team working at the intersection of AI/ML innovation and cloud-scale engineering. As part of our growing Data and AI division, we’re looking for a passionate Machine Learning / AI Developer to help us build intelligent systems using open-source tools and major cloud platforms. What You'll Do: Research, adapt, and customize open-source AI/ML algorithms for real-world applications Build, deploy, and optimize solutions on AWS, Google Cloud (GCP), and Azure using their AI/ML services Design, develop, and maintain robust and scalable ML codebases in Python Contribute to proof-of-concept development, experimentation, and model evaluation Collaborate closely with data engineers and software developers to integrate models into production systems What We're Looking For: Proven experience in Machine Learning and AI development (4+ years preferred) Strong expertise in Python programming, especially for ML workflows (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, etc.) Experience working with cloud ML/AI services: SageMaker (AWS), Vertex AI (GCP), Azure ML Studio, etc. Familiarity with open-source ML libraries and ability to fine-tune/customize them Ability to think critically, research independently, and communicate clearly Nice to Have: Contributions to open-source projects Exposure to MLOps practices and tools (e.g., MLFlow, Kubeflow, Airflow) Background in data engineering or DevOps for ML Experience deploying models to production or real-time systems Why Join Us: Competitive salaries and benefits Long-term cooperation with insurance Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI/ML projects Work with a supportive and technically strong team You will be our guest for lunch
